page.overview:
Who is Sean Schrider?

Sean Schrider, aka Willy the Kid, was an obnoxious radio DJ at WURG station. After he caught Allyson Nelson and Corey Cunningham making out on the roof of his station on 30 October, he threatened and insulted them. As punishment for his taunts, Corey murdered him the following Halloween night. After killing radio receptionist Susan, Corey entered the DJ's office and bashed his head against the table then severed his tongue with scissors, leaving him to die. His severed tongue was spun around on his record player. He had not heard Susan being murdered as he was too focused on his music, and was shocked to see Corey's reflection in the window before being killed.
